summary: Iter21 RETEST: verified fix for /api/balance-detail?kind=kas double-counting POS+payment_method sales. Added the same exclusion filter (server.py L419-420: `if s.get('channel')=='POS' and s.get('payment_method'): continue`) applied inside the kas kind loop. Ran iter20 test suite serially (-n 0): 23/23 PASSED (added 1 new invariant test test_balance_detail_kas_matches_reports_kas_exact which asserts reports.balance.detail.assets.lancar.kas == sum(balance-detail?kind=kas rows with in/out sign) exactly). Fix confirmed: reports.kas == drill.kas (diff=0). No regressions in POS QRIS cash_movement, POS bayar_nanti piutang creation, non-POS sales, receivables/payables, ledger, inventory, or payment_methods summary.
critical_code_review_comments: Fix is minimal and correct — single-line exclusion mirrors the same guard used in /api/reports op_cash_in loop, keeping the two code paths consistent.

Suggestion (non-blocking): extract a helper `_is_pos_auto_cashmovement(sale)` to DRY the identical predicate across reports.py and balance-detail — currently duplicated in 2 places, will drift if a 3rd payment_method behavior is added.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iter20 test file now has 23 tests including exact-match invariant for kas. If future work touches sales_transactions/POS/cash_movements, re-run this file first. The POS+payment_method exclusion pattern is duplicated in server.py at op_cash_in loop AND balance-detail kas loop — keep them in sync.
